transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer service, my name is Edward. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: hi Edward um I got a new iPhone fifteen yesterday and I'm trying to transfer my eSIM from my old phone but it's just stuck on activating and now neither phone gets any signal

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand how inconvenient it is to be left without cellular reception on both handsets, Noah. I will get your eSIM profile refreshed and activated right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: thanks man yeah I have to travel for work tomorrow so I really need this sorted

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we access your mobile account, Noah, could you verify your full billing address and your four-digit security PIN for me?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yeah sure it's 53 Westbourne Grove London W11 2RU and the pin is four eight one zero

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for verifying those details, Noah. I have your Unlimited 5G mobile account open in front of me.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: cool thanks for pulling that up so quickly

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I have understood correctly, you are attempting to migrate your eSIM from an older handset to a new iPhone 15, but the carrier activation stalled and left both devices showing No Service. Have I got that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yeah exactly that like the little circle just spins on setting up cellular and then says unable to complete eSIM transfer

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That typically happens when the previous device holds the cryptographic token because the old eSIM was not deleted prior to requesting the new profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: oh right I didn't know I had to delete it from the old phone first

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No problem at all, that is very common. On your old phone, go into Settings, then Mobile Service, and tap Remove eSIM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: okay doing that now... tap remove... confirm remove... okay the old phone now says no SIM card installed

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What is the EID number of your new iPhone 15? You can find it under Settings, General, About.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: let me see... EID is eight nine zero four nine zero three two zero zero zero one eight four two five nine zero one

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And the IMEI number on the same screen?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: IMEI is three five four zero nine eight one one zero four eight two nine one five

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And is there an IMEI 2 listed below that for the digital SIM slot?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yes IMEI two is three five four zero nine eight one one zero four eight two nine two three

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. I am generating a brand new carrier direct push profile straight to Apple's activation servers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: does that mean I don't need a QR code email?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, direct push delivers the profile straight to your iOS screen as a system prompt, which is much faster than scanning a QR code.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: oh that's sweet nice and easy

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please bear with me while I place you on a brief hold for about a minute while I commit the profile exchange.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Noah. The new eSIM profile has been pushed to your handset.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: whoa yeah a notification just popped up on the screen saying S-Net Mobile Plan Ready to Install

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Tap that notification and select Continue, then set it as your primary line for voice, SMS, and mobile data.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: tapping continue... it says activating... and boom! Full five G bars at the top of the screen!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could you turn off Wi-Fi on your phone and try making a test call or opening a website over cellular?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: turning Wi-Fi off... loading BBC news... loads instantly on five G. Let me call my voicemail on one two one... voicemail connected!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms voice, data, and IMS registration are fully working on the new device, Noah.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let's check your APN settings to ensure your multimedia messages and personal hotspot function without issues.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: where do I check the APN settings in the menu?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go to Settings, Mobile Service, Mobile Data Network. The Access Point Name should say idata.s-net.co.uk.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: looking at Mobile Data Network... yes, APN shows idata.s-net.co.uk and username and password are blank.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is the correct carrier profile. Now test your personal hotspot toggle under Settings.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: toggling personal hotspot... it switched on immediately without any pop-up asking me to contact S-Net!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now check iMessage and FaceTime under Settings, Messages. Does your mobile number show with a blue checkmark next to it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: checking Messages... yes, my phone number has a spinning wheel for two seconds and then showed a blue checkmark!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms your telephone number has successfully bound to Apple's push notification identity server.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: awesome, that means my blue text bubbles won't show as my email address to friends.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You mentioned earlier you are traveling for work tomorrow, Noah. Are you traveling abroad or within the UK?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: oh yeah I'm flying out to Frankfurt in Germany for three days for a tech expo

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our European Roaming Pass covers full 5G data, calls, and texts across Germany for just two pounds a day, capped at your domestic bundle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: does that kick in automatically when I land, or do I have to activate it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It activates automatically the moment your phone connects to the Deutsche Telekom or Vodafone network in Germany.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: and is data roaming turned on by default in my phone settings?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will just need to go to Settings, Mobile Service, Mobile Data Options, and toggle Data Roaming to On.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: got it, toggled on right now so I don't forget when I land.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've also checked your international roaming bar and confirmed your account is completely unbarred for EU roaming.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: awesome, that saves me paying hotel Wi-Fi charges.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Do you also use Wi-Fi Calling when you are in areas with weak indoor mobile signal?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yes in my basement flat reception is patchy so Wi-Fi calling is super useful

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let's make sure Wi-Fi Calling is enabled on the new handset under Settings, Phone, Wi-Fi Calling.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: checking Phone settings... Wi-Fi Calling was off, just switched it to On now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under Voice and Data, make sure 5G Auto is selected rather than 5G On so you preserve battery life throughout your travel days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: switched to 5G Auto, great tip for battery saving.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. When you are connected to home broadband, your calls will route over Wi-Fi with crystal clear audio.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: brilliant, everything is set up better than on my old phone now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also set up a monthly spend cap of zero pounds on your roaming so you can never incur unexpected international charges.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: that gives me great peace of mind, thank you Edward.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Everything on your profile is verified and active on the S-Net mobile network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Edward you've been top quality today mate, thanks for getting both the eSIM and the roaming sorted so fast.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my absolute pleasure, Noah. Is there anything else I can assist with regarding your mobile plan?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: no that's everything sorted out cheers!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net today, Noah. Safe travels to Frankfurt and enjoy the expo.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: thanks Edward bye!
